text:
[issue by Cassy-Lee]
### Minecraft Version

1.21

### What happened?

As described in the title, Curios API for 1.21(.1) depends on neoforge `[21.1.60,)` (in `neoforge.mods.toml`), but newest neoforge for 1.21 was `21.0.167`.
Please change supported minecraft version for those files on curseforge to 1.21.1 only.
If compatible, please use `[21.0,)` for neoforge version range and make a new release for 1.21.

### Relevant Log Outputs

_No response_

[comment by Cassy-Lee (none)]
All releases for 1.21(.1) have this problem.

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
Thanks for notifying me of this oversight, I've fixed this issue and have marked the affected files as being for 1.21.1 only.
